title: List
summary: A list a person acts on -- conversations, letters, templates, files, members, versions: rows from data drawn as sf-list-item, grouped by day or by key, one Tab stop, the open row, row actions in one shared menu, rename in place, the next page at the end, an empty state. Fetches nothing; every request is an event.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

selected.description: The id of the open row: aria-current and the open tint. Controlled: a press asks open {id}, the host writes it back.

group-by.description: none: one list. day: by the calendar day of each item's date in the reader's time zone (Сегодня, Вчера, a weekday, the date). key: by each item's group, in the order of groups.

selection.description: Choosing several rows (owner decision C167 (5) by the rule of C150 (9)). many: a check box at each row's start, shown under the pointer and on the focused row, and on every row once anything is chosen; then a press on a row chooses it (Enter still opens), Shift a range, Space on the focused row chooses it, a phone chooses by a long press (the row's menu stays on its «⋯»). The bar of the choice is sf-bulk-actions (C295) at the list's bottom with selection-actions; its × and Escape let the choice go. The choice is the value chosen and the event select.

renamable.description: Rows are renamed in place: F2 and «Переименовать» in the menu; rename {id, text} says the new name.

has-more.description: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (owner decision C167 (1)): the end of a list is sf-pagination appearance="more" after it (its button, «Показано X из Y», load=button|auto, sf-pagination-load-more); noted once per element in SF.deprecations, journal attribute-list-has-more-to-pagination-more. A next page exists: «Показать ещё» shows, and the end brought into reach by a person's scroll asks for it (an end in reach on load waits for the button or the first scroll).

loading.description: The first page is on its way: three skeleton rows of the list's size, each as tall as the row that replaces it (the caption row until rows were shown, then the shape of the rows shown, their leading icon or avatar place included, so the title starts where it will), their words core's pulsing first-paint bars (C130, C136, C148 (1)).

leading.description: The leading place the skeleton rows keep while loading, from the first frame: auto takes the shape of the rows the list has shown (none until it has shown any); icon keeps the icon place (the row's line square, the control radius); avatar keeps sf-avatar's own box of the list's step (the control height while the rows have a second line, else the row's line), a circle (square when the rows shown were); none keeps no place. So a list whose rows will carry icons or avatars has its title bar start on the first frame where the title will. It shapes the skeleton alone: the rows draw what their items carry (C130, C148 (1)).

lines.description: The line count of the skeleton rows while loading, from the first frame: auto takes the rows the list has shown (the caption row until it has shown any); 1 keeps one-line rows (the row's height, an avatar of the row's line); 2 keeps rows with a second line (the caption row, an avatar of the control height). So a one-line list's first skeleton row is as tall as its rows and its title bar where the title will be, whatever leading says. It shapes the skeleton alone: the rows draw what their items carry (C130).

size.description: The rows' step on the size ladder (sf-list-item size); the «⋯» and the rename field take the same.

no-wrap.description: Every row's whole text is its tooltip (title), cut or not. A row's title and its second line are one line each, cut at the end with an ellipsis, with or without it (owner decision C148 (5)); a cut row says its whole text in its tooltip by itself, and the whole text stays in the row for a screen reader. Kept for the lists that set it.

divided.description: An inset line under every row but the last of its group, from the row's text to the list's edge under the «⋯» (sf-list-item divided, owner decision C148 (4)); off, the rows have no lines and the groups are told apart by their headings (C40)

time-format.description: The row's time at its end, from the item's date, drawn by sf-time (C40) without a tooltip or a Tab stop of its own (the row is the list's one stop): on the title's line of a two-line row, above the count and the badge (sf-list-item's end column, C148 (2)), in the caption's type and dim ink, the main ink on an unread row. none (the default): no time. auto: under a day heading (group-by day) the clock time («11:20»), since the heading names the day; elsewhere -- ungrouped, by key, the pinned group -- sf-time auto («28 минут назад», «11:20», «вчера, 19:40», «5 ноября»). relative: always relative. exact: the clock time under a day heading, the date and time elsewhere. The values are sf-list-timeline's time-format, plus none.

label.description: The list's accessible name; empty is «List» in the page's language.

heading-level.description: The level of the groups' headings in the page's outline.

sticky-headings.description: The group headings stay in sight while the list scrolls (block list's sticky heading, C40), the place's solid surface behind them

rows-window.description: auto: up to 1 000 entries (rows, and the headings of a grouped list) every row stays in the document, a long list's rows (100 and more) drawn with content-visibility so the browser's find and printing reach them; from 1 000 (or rows-window-from) the entries in view and two spacers for the rest (core rows window; owner decision C308 FO-2). off: every row stays in the document at any length (FO2-3).

rows-window-from.description: The length from which rows-window auto draws the entries in view (owner decision C308 FO-2): 1 000 by default; a list sets its own, a whole number above 0.

accept-files.description: The whole list takes files dragged from the computer (owner decision C308 FO-1): a folder, a chat, attachments. While files are held over it the page's one drop overlay says «Отпустите, чтобы загрузить в «{label}»»; a drop asks the host with attach. Off by default.

empty-text.description: The empty state's heading (sf-empty-state no-data); the empty slot replaces the whole state.

items.description: The rows, in the host's order: {id, text, supporting?, icon?, avatar?, date?, group?, count?, badge?, pinned?, disabled?, actions?}.

groups.description: With group-by key: the groups in order, [{key, text}]; a key not listed follows, its key as its heading.

actions.description: The row actions in the shared menu, after «Переименовать»: [{id, text, icon?, destructive?}]. Chosen, one leaves as apply {action, scope: entry, ids}.

selection-actions.description: With selection many, the actions of the choice's bar, in sf-bulk-actions' own shape [{id, text, icon?, status?, confirm?, undo?}]: up to three as buttons, the rest in «⋯», a dangerous one last and asked about. Chosen, one leaves as apply {action, scope: selection, ids}.

chosen.description: With selection many, the ids of the rows chosen, in the list's order. A page may write it (a list of ids) to choose; a row that leaves the list leaves the choice. It is not selected, which is the one open row.

id.description: The stable key of the item.

supporting.description: A quiet second line under the title.

icon.description: A glyph before the title (a Material Symbols name).

avatar.description: The row's picture (sf-avatar): an image, the initials in text, or a sign (icon without an image); square for a group or a channel.

date.description: ISO 8601; with group-by day, the calendar day it is grouped under.

group.description: With group-by key, the key of its group.

disabled.description: Shown, not opened, renamed or acted on.

actions.description: false: no row actions; a list of action ids: only those.

count.description: A count at the row's end (unread); 0 draws nothing, above 99 «99+».

unread.description: Unread without a count: the title semibold and the word «не прочитано» for a screen reader.

badge.description: A short tonal badge at the row's end, before the count.

pinned.description: Leads the list, under its own heading when the list is grouped.

item.description: Plain data; any further fields are the host's.

setItems.summary: The whole list and whether more follows, together; ends a page request.

detach.summary: Take one item off; the focus on it goes to its neighbour.

rename.summary: Start renaming a row in place, as F2 does.

openMenu.summary: Open a row's actions, as its «⋯» and Shift+F10 do.

requestMore.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (owner decision C167 (1)): the end of a list is sf-pagination appearance="more" after it (its button, «Показано X из Y», load=button|auto, sf-pagination-load-more); noted once per element in SF.deprecations, journal attribute-list-has-more-to-pagination-more. Ask for the next page, as reaching the end and «Показать ещё» do; nothing while a request is out.

moreFailed.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (owner decision C167 (1)): the end of a list is sf-pagination appearance="more" after it (its button, «Показано X из Y», load=button|auto, sf-pagination-load-more); noted once per element in SF.deprecations, journal attribute-list-has-more-to-pagination-more. The next page could not be loaded: «Показать ещё» and the end ask again.

clearSelection.summary: Lets every chosen row go (selection many) and sends select. Refused (empty) when nothing is chosen.

toggleChosen.summary: Chooses a row or lets it go, as a press does once a row is chosen; range chooses every row from the last one pressed (Shift). Refused when selection is not many or the row is unknown or disabled.

sf-list-open.summary: A row is asked for (vocabulary open): a press or Enter; the host opens it and writes selected back.

sf-list-apply.summary: One of the row actions was chosen: {action, scope: entry, ids}; or an action of the choice's bar (selection many): {action, scope: selection, ids} with the rows chosen (vocabulary apply).

sf-list-rename.summary: A row was renamed in place; the new text is shown at once. Cancel it to keep the old text.

sf-list-load-more.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (owner decision C167 (1)): the end of a list is sf-pagination appearance="more" after it (its button, «Показано X из Y», load=button|auto, sf-pagination-load-more); noted once per element in SF.deprecations, journal attribute-list-has-more-to-pagination-more. The next page is asked for: a person's scroll brought the end into reach, or «Показать ещё»: {direction: after, after}. Never on load by itself. Cancelling it is moreFailed().

after.description: The id of the last row shown.

sf-list-attach.summary: Files were dropped on the list (accept-files, owner decision C308 FO-1): the request to attach them there (vocabulary §5 attach); skipped names the folders left out. The list uploads nothing itself.

sf-list-select.summary: The choice changed (selection many): the ids of the rows chosen, their count and the number of rows. Its DOM name is sf-list-select.

untrusted_inputs: item text and supporting line (drawn as text)

accessibility.focus: One Tab stop for the whole list: the row last moved to, else the open one, else the first. Arrows, Home and End move between rows across groups; Enter opens; F2 opens the rename field and takes the focus into it, Enter keeps, Escape gives up, and the focus comes back to the row; Shift+F10 or the menu key opens the row's actions and the menu gives the focus back. A row taken off gives the focus to its neighbour.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-list for a list a person acts on -- conversations, letters, templates, files, members, versions: open a row, rename it, its actions, the next page. For a column a person reads from the newest at the end use sf-list-feed; for a choice in a field use sf-dropdown.
do_not: Do not fetch or sort in the element; give the items in order and answer its events
Do not pass markup in text or supporting; they are text
Do not apply an action in the element; answer apply and update the items
